excerpts.content:
zkVM Standards v0 is here! 🎉

The zkEVM team has published three initial standards to reduce fragmentation across the zkVM ecosystem:
• RV64IM+Zicclsm common ISA
• C interface for precompiles
• C interface for guest IO

This is v0 - we expect them to evolve!

https://zkevm.ethereum.foundation/blog/zkevm-standards-v0-release
